title: HADAL – a deep-sea exploration game where every pixel and every sound is generated by code Claude wrote
author: slinto
selftext:
HADAL is a free browser game about piloting a submersible from a research ship off Guam down to the floor of Challenger Deep, almost 11 km below the surface. No combat – the tension comes from physics and energy: you sink on steel weights, drop them to rise, and the battery has to last the whole way back up.



\*\*What the AI made\*\* (Claude Code, TypeScript + Phaser 4, \~26,000 lines):

\- The simulation: buoyancy, drag, added mass, pressure on the hull, a battery that loses capacity in the cold, and an auto-hold that keeps altitude over a sloping seafloor

\- All the art: pixel art as generators in code – no image files – with normal maps derived automatically so the lamp lights the shapes. Even the app icon and link preview are drawn at build time

\- All the sound: synthesised live with Web Audio, no audio files

\- 45 real deep-sea species with sources, plus procedurally invented ones that are always labelled as invented

\- \~400 tests, including whole simulated dives and fuzz tests that pilot randomly



\*\*What I did:\*\* design, direction and playtesting. I set a few pillars at the start ("physics is a game mechanic – you may simplify, never lie", "no combat", "failure doesn't punish brutally") and every feature had to fit them.



\*\*What worked:\*\*

\- A short project file with the pillars and conventions, so every session started from the same rules

\- Making it check every visual change with a real screenshot instead of trusting the code

\- Real facts only with a source; anything invented gets a label



\*\*Where it needed a human:\*\* fun. The first testers said the dive felt great but there was little to do besides taking photos, and the controls felt sluggish. The physics was right – the design wasn't. So we added trimming and an automatic altitude hold (like real ROVs), objects to find on the seafloor (a whale fall, a lost container, wrecks) that the sonar hints at, and a red lamp that shy animals can't see but that only works up close.



Play (browser and phone, no signup): [https://game-hadal.vercel.app/en/](https://game-hadal.vercel.app/en/)

Trailer (28 s, the game's own sound): [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LHp4OL-E4RQ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LHp4OL-E4RQ)



I'd love feedback on the game itself – and happy to answer anything about the process.

comments.author: LostAstronaut2k
comments.body: hi sir, i played your game for a good 3-4 hours in the last few days. Very relaxing game you can play while multi-tasking! I've reached a point where I'm stuck somehow. i bought the hrov-2 but for some reason i cant select points on the map where its deeper, trying to "drive" from another point is not working since i run out of battery.  The radar is very hard to read, red light could go a bit farther (cant really use it as is), i'm running a bit bored due to the lack of new stuff (I know, deeper does not have that many thing to see but its quite repetitive).  give me a way to see the tasks while diving (if you click on X they disappear but dont know how to make them appear), give me more details on why i make/loose money at the end of the dive. Very good game, congrats!!
